label: Software, Operating Systems, Languages and Databases
blurb: A focused six-fact drill set for Software, Operating Systems, Languages and Databases.

topics.title: Operating system
topics.hook: An operating system manages hardware resources and provides common services to applications.
topics.explainer: An operating system manages hardware resources and provides common services to applications. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Software, Operating Systems, Languages and Databases

connections.fact: Linux is the kernel at the centre of many operating systems, which add user tools and services around that kernel.
A compiler runs under an operating system and produces executable code for a particular platform or runtime.

topics.title: Linux
topics.hook: Linux is an open-source kernel created by Linus Torvalds and first released in 1991.
topics.explainer: Linux is an open-source kernel created by Linus Torvalds and first released in 1991. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Software, Operating Systems, Languages and Databases

connections.fact: Linux manages core hardware access as a kernel; a complete Linux distribution combines it with libraries, utilities, and applications.
Python programs commonly run on Linux systems, but Python is a programming language whereas Linux is a kernel.

topics.title: Compiler
topics.hook: A compiler translates high-level source code into machine code or another executable form.
topics.explainer: A compiler translates high-level source code into machine code or another executable form. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Software, Operating Systems, Languages and Databases

connections.fact: A compiler translates source code before execution; Python is commonly executed through an interpreter and bytecode virtual machine, though implementations may compile stages internally.
Compilers create or prepare programs for an operating system and processor combination.

topics.title: Python
topics.hook: Python is a high-level programming language created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.
topics.explainer: Python is a high-level programming language created by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Software, Operating Systems, Languages and Databases

connections.fact: Python can control application logic and send SQL statements to a database, while SQL specialises in defining and querying relational data.

connections.relationship: Language frequently deployed on the kernel
connections.fact: Python is a language and runtime often installed on Linux-based operating systems; the two are not competing software categories.

topics.title: SQL
topics.hook: SQL is the standard language for querying and managing relational databases.
topics.explainer: SQL is the standard language for querying and managing relational databases. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Software, Operating Systems, Languages and Databases

connections.fact: SQL creates, reads, updates, and controls table-based data held by relational database systems.
A Python application can use a database driver to execute SQL while keeping business logic in Python.

topics.title: Relational database
topics.hook: A relational database stores data in tables whose rows can be linked using keys.
topics.explainer: A relational database stores data in tables whose rows can be linked using keys. It is a useful TCS Quiz recall point because questions often test the term, person, date, or application together.
topics.category: Software, Operating Systems, Languages and Databases

connections.relationship: Data model and its standard query language
connections.fact: Relational databases organise rows into linked tables, and SQL is the standard language used to work with those tables.
A database server depends on the operating system for files, memory, processes, and device access.

questions.q: Which software layer schedules processes, manages memory, and mediates access to hardware?
questions.explanation: Resource management and common application services are operating-system responsibilities, distinct from translating code or querying data.

questions.q: Which statement carefully distinguishes Linux from a complete operating system?
options: Linux is a database query language
Linux is the open-source kernel used in many operating systems
Linux is a Python compiler only
Linux is a relational table format
questions.explanation: Linus Torvalds released the Linux kernel in 1991; distributions combine that kernel with utilities, libraries, and applications.

questions.q: A team wants source code translated into a machine-executable form before deployment. Which tool is central?
questions.explanation: A compiler translates a high-level program into machine code, bytecode, or another target representation used for execution.

questions.q: Which creator-and-year pair belongs to Python?
questions.explanation: Guido van Rossum created Python and first released it in 1991; Torvalds's 1991 release was the Linux kernel.

questions.q: A user needs all customer rows whose balance exceeds a threshold. Which language is designed to express that query?
questions.explanation: SQL is the standard declarative language for selecting and managing table data in relational database systems.

questions.q: What lets rows in separate relational tables be associated?
questions.explanation: Primary and foreign keys identify records and express relationships across tables without placing all data in one table.
Linux is an open-source kernel, not a spreadsheet format; the other three pairings describe their normal roles.

questions.q: A Python service must retrieve records from a relational database. What is the sensible division of labour?
options: Python handles application logic; SQL expresses the database query
Linux stores every row as a key
questions.explanation: Application code can call a database driver and submit SQL while Python controls validation, workflow, and response handling.

options: SQL and Python are both operating-system kernels
SQL specialises in relational data; Python is general purpose
Python can only define database tables
SQL was created by Linus Torvalds
questions.explanation: SQL focuses on defining and querying structured relational data, whereas Python supports a much wider range of programming tasks.

questions.q: A designer stores customers once and links orders to them by customer ID. Which model is being used?
questions.explanation: Separate customer and order tables linked by a key are a classic application of the relational model.
